PreparedPayload.Description: Retained prepared array element bytes, including cloned coordinates, edges, scalar bounds and sorted endpoints. Excludes array/object headers, shared source catalogue and mutable engine scratch; not peak memory.

Profiles.Command: dotnet-trace collect --profile dotnet-sampled-thread-time --format Speedscope -- dotnet <measured-runner.dll> profile-double-ablation Guarded-prepared 20
Profiles.Limit: Managed sampled thread time within TraverseReal, including its warmup calls. Inclusive shares overlap. JIT inlining affects attribution. These are not exact CPU percentages or benchmark timings.
